superficial: The largest fragment that has ever arrived, stuck on its edge in the dust. At the top its edge is cut in a perfect curve, like the stones in the display cases.
On its face, a ring of clock marks and three notches: a date, in the count of the Absent. As the Teacher taught you to read them, it is older than every stone that arrived before it.
Deep in the cut there is a thread of light that comes from nowhere.
profunda: It arrived last, but it comes from before any of them.
Each mouth has its own clock: what comes out of one may come from a different time than what comes out of another.
